title: THE ONLY APP THAT HELPS (2 months daily use)
text: I scoured the App Store for routine supporting apps. When I found a well-reviewed app that met the criteria I had in mind, I put in hours of testing. I ended up trying out Structured, Habit Hub, Tiimo, Brili Routines, & Time Bloc. Tiimo came the closest to the functionality of Routinery, but it was so glitchy it was unusable.   I’ve been using this app for 2 months so far. It is SO HELPFUL for my executive function issues (late-diagnosed adult ADHD and ASD). Routinery offers the ability to build what I call “routine playlists” (abbreviated as rp henceforth). Some of the apps I tested also have this function. Routinery’s playlists are unique because: 1))) each task in the rp is assigned a duration & when the rp runs each task has a timer (essential for me, because I have time-blindness), 2))) rps & individual tasks can be aperiodic (free from scheduling) OR scheduled, 3))) when an rp is running, tasks *do not* autocomplete until I press the ✅ (unless I select the “auto-next” setting for that specific task), 4))) audio & voice notifications are available at a variety of intervals to indicate the beginning, time remaining, and end of a task, as well as a stopwatch count of time elapsed since the anticipated task completion point if I’ve gone over time on a task and time elapsed since rp was paused (so useful because I often get distracted & completely forget I’ve paused an rp), 5))) creating, skipping & reordering tasks is much quicker & simpler than other apps I tested.

title: 一つだけ改善してほしいこと
text:
機能には非常に満足しています。

しかし、一点だけ不満なところがあるのです。
それは、ルーティンの終わりを告げる音です。
無論、できる限りの対策はしています。

settingからタイマー終了通知は全てオフにしているし(完了時のみonで固定されている)、タイマー一時停止通知も全てオフ。ボリュームは、設定の「着信音と触覚」とコントロールセンター共に、常に最低まで下げています。
それらの障壁を乗り越えて、このアプリはルーティンの終了をデカデカと告げるのです。

今私には、大きな音を心から嫌い敬遠する同居人がいます。私が改善することを条件にどうにか我慢してもらっていたのですが、ついに先日「もう使わないで！」と釘を刺されました。
このままではこのアプリを使えなくなりそうです。

お願いです。
どうか、「デイリーが終了しました！」と大きな声で読み上げない選択ができるように、アップデートしてください。いつまでも待ちます。
よろしくお願いします。

title: Amazing
text: This by far has been my favorite habit/routine builder/tracker. I like the fact that it allows you to place time limits for each task that you place on your your routine. With this feature it allows you make a realistic well timed routine. I also love the feature that tells you how much time has gone by since you ended the previous task if you don’t immediately move to the next task because there is a pause feature which is great if your a busy mom like me and need to pause for any reason. Then the reminder feature will remind you how much time has gone by which is great because sometimes I’ll forget what I’m doing when I have to stop and tend to my kiddos or my husband.

title: Frustrating Bugs!
text:
EDIT: 
Updating my review as many of the bugs and glitches mentioned in the previous review, which I'll leave down below, have been addressed, though sometimes they still occur, which is why I'm leaving my initial review.
However, after reading through many of the other reviews, I find that I agree with one consistent complaint, aside from the bugs: the subscription-based pay system. I would buy this app in a heartbeat, if it were a one time fee, as opposed to being a reoccurring subscription.
I also find that they words things in a way where it is easy for people to misunderstand exactly what they are buying. For example, it is currently in the middle of January 2023, and they are running a sale for New Year's Day. Right now, it said that I can buy a one-month, three-month, or yearly subscription at a discount and also receive an additional code for the same amount of time. So basically, if I bought the yearly subscription, I would get a code that would cover a subscription for an additional year--2 years total. I
 almost bought this in a heartbeat, but I am glad that I waited. In very small fine print (that is a light gray text color against a white background, so barely visible) it states that the code cannot be used for yourself, but must be given to someone else so that you can "gift" Routinery to a loved one. Personally, I find this very sneaky and deceiving. 
Every time I decide that I would like to subscribe to the app--because it actually has helped me a lot whenever I use the two routines that come with the free version--the developer makes me change my mind by either being slow to fix bugs that have been reported and complained about for months, or they pull deceptive tricks in order to get money.
To the developer, I suggest you heed the advice of your users and either adjust the pay system, or consider lowering the fee, seeing as it is taking months, and sometimes even over a year for certain bugs to be fixed. From what I am gathering, it sounds like either a single person or a very small team is working on this app, so I completely understand not being able to keep up with requests and fixing bugs in a fast manner, but the price for the app paired with the bugs are not a good match.
 
-------------
Original Review
The premise of this app is a great one, but there are so many bugs that this feels like a beta version of the app instead of a full release. I cannot select any icons at all (except for those in the “morning“ page) to assign to a task. In order to be able to select any other icons in their icon library, I have to click “randomize” until I happen to fall on an icon that relates to the task that I’m inputting. I even tried deleting the entire app to see if the download had simply glitched out, but the problem persists. It’s extremely frustrating to try to add a task when it takes five minutes of pressing the randomize icon button and hoping that you happen upon an icon that’s somewhat related to your task. And this is with the trial version of the paid subscription. I honestly am surprised that they are charging money for this whenever the app is so broken. I think the app could use a great deal of fixing before it is released to the public. As it stands right now, the app is so glitchy, it crashes and loses my progress constantly. I hate it because honestly, this is the one system that I found that actually seemed to work for me; initially, when I followed the tutorial and created a morning routine, it worked out great. However, the bugs quickly showed up soon after. Developers, has this bug for the icons and the inability to select specific icon categories or even specific icons themselves been noted before? And if so, is there a fix coming soon? I really want to like this app, but so far, the bugs are making it really hard to do so. Edit: lowering my review to one star based on customer “support.” I emailed the developers about several bugs I am experiencing and was told simply to make sure I was upgraded to the latest version. I told them this information already as I stated in my first email I even deleted the app and re-downloaded in an attempt to fix the problem, but the problems persisted. They still have not contacted back after that single, very unhelpful reply. Scrolling through the reviews, it seems like everyone is complaining about the same bugs, some even from a year ago. And it doesn’t look like the developer(s) are listening. I love the idea of this app, but the support from the developer is severely lacking. I planned to buy the subscription but will be looking elsewhere for an app that is more properly managed. If anyone has any suggestions, I’d love if you would leave them in your review to check them out! UPDATE: The bugs mentioned in the initial review have since been fixed, but now, a new major bug has taken their place. When starting a routine, the screen suddenly goes completely white except for the top half where it displays part of the screen. Then the routine begins, but it cuts to the last task. Ending the routine and restarting it usually helps, but I noticed after that occurs, each timed task suddenly randomly completes itself. For example, I have a morning routine and it will be on a task like “get dressed” which is set to last for 2 minutes, but the timer makes the “complete” sound after it has only run for maybe 15 seconds and it jumps to the very next task.

title: Best Routine App!
text: Words aren’t adequate enough to describe how much I adore this app. I tried a bunch of productivity/routine apps, but this was the best one!! I used to struggle so much with getting ready in the morning and before bed, but this app has seriously fixed most of my problems with that. While I will admit it only lets you have two free routines, the free version of this app is actually still amazing!!! Even without premium, you can have your routines as long as you want and set exactly how long each task is. It also lets you rearrange things as you go if your routine doesn’t go as planned/needs to be altered. And one of the best features is how a voice reads out when your current task is finished and tells you what the next one is! It also warns you when you only have a minute left if the task is a longer one. Even when you don’t have the app pulled up on your phone, it continues to run in the background and sends you alerts throughout your routine! I recommend this for ANYONE who finds it hard to keep track of routines, especially if you’re neurodivergent like I am!!

title: Great app- needs calendar integration
text:
I’ve been using this app for 7 days, and my self esteem has improved so much. The UI and functionality is great- I love how you have to complete the routine or you receive notifications, and I love the reminders to stay on target to finish a task. I use it with my toddler son for his bedtime routine. I schedule my whole day with it. I feel like a super person now. 

I wish there was a google calendar integration that would turn events into routine items. If an event is added, its duration and start time come preset, and any routine items can be added around the fixed time items.

title: The app you can’t live without after trying
text:
If you’ve ever read the book “what the most successful people do before breakfast,” then you’re aware of the concept of writing every task down that you want accomplished, about how long each task takes, and what time you want to have it completed. I went from “tracking” on a notepad to randomly finding this in the App Store one day looking for if there was a better way for me to do it. 

Gamechanger, life saver, I can’t get through my mornings without it. 

I thought making my bagel took me 1 minute- nope, about 2 minutes to toast, the time it takes to get the jam and a knife out, and to put said knife in the dishwasher- I’m looking at 5 minutes for a bagel. May be a dumb example, but this app not only holds you to the times set for yourself, it makes you well aware of how much time you ACTUALLY take to accomplish a task. 

My morning routine starts with simply get out of bed, make bed, bathroom, etc, etc, and ends with how long my route to work is. If I want to be at work by 730? Then guess what- I’m leaving at 717, not in shambles running out the door at 725 in hopes I make it on time. Nope, because I have a tracker that is keeping tabs on me and I’m therefore keeping tabs on myself. 

Get this app. Just do it. It will completely change the way you tackle your mornings and nights and days

2023년 3월 기준 몇가지 제안 드리고 싶은 기능은 

1. 아이콘 검색 기능 : 분야별로 나누어져있기는 하지만 거기서 일일히 눈으로 확인하고 골라야해서 조금 귀찮습니다. 루티너리 최강점 중 하나가 ‘예쁨’인 만큼 아이콘 검색이 가능했으면 합니다.

2. 소셜 검색 기능 : 다른 사람들의 ’기상‘ 루틴은 뭔지, ‘퇴근 후’ 루틴은 어떤 식으로들 구성하시는지, 검색이 가능 & 내 루틴으로 추가 가능하면 소셜 기능이 훨씬 활성화될 것 같습니다.

3. 단축어 기능 : 자동화로 <앱 열기> 뿐 아니라 개별 루틴 바로 실행가능했으면 좋겠습니다ㅠㅠ 제발ㅜㅠㅠㅠ 이거 설정하다가 밤샜어요ㅠㅜㅠ

title: Really great! Except for subscription & robotic voice

That’s way too much to ask for such a narrow app. If they don’t offer a lifetime subscription option in the next couple of months, I will move on. It’s main advantage over competitors is UI and Apple Watch app. If you don’t use a watch, Routine Flow is just as good, a little less pretty, But WAY cheaper.

I also find the voice announcement very robotic and off-putting to me. I would love more voice options.

text: 다른 루틴 앱 써보려다가 번거로워서 포기했는데 이 어플 좋은 것 같아서 계속 써보려고요. 지금 초기 설정 중인데 이런 기능이 있으면 좋겠다 싶은 것들 적어봅니다..! 1. 내가 만든 루틴 항목을 저장하여 루틴 목록을 새로 만들 때 저장된 항목을 쉽게 불러와서 추가할 수 있으면 좋을 것 같아요. 그럼 루틴 목록 만들 때 시간이 훨씬 절약될 수 있을 것 같습니다. 2. 루틴 항목에 "특정 요일/특정 일에만 활성화" 기능이 있다면 좋을 것 같아요. 특정 요일에만 분리수거를 한다던가, 매달 특정일에 반려묘 모래 전체갈이를 하는 등으로 활용하기 좋을 것 같습니다. (특정 요일에 반복은 나중에 꼭 업데이트 됐으면 좋겠어요..!) 이 어플은 내가 항목 하나하나마다 계속 추가하고, 루틴이 익숙해지기 전까지 설정한 루틴을 들여다보지 않아도 되게 시각화했다는 점이 정말 좋은 것 같아요. 루틴을 확인하다 핸드폰을 하면서 삼천포에 빠지지 않을 수 있다는 점도 좋고요! 좋은 어플 감사합니다.

title: Glitchy
text: I really liked the app and used it for almost a year. I did have to cancel my subscription because it was too glitchy. Often my phone app wouldn’t start up, I’d have to delete and download the app again for it to work. On my Apple Watch, the routines would go out of sync or just not register when I finished a routine or tapped to move to the next section. Wrote the creators about it, but they didn’t have an answer or a solution (they offered some tips and were very quick in their response). Ultimately, it created additional friction to use routinery and didn’t work for me.

title: One of my favourites
text:
I love this app, it has seriously helped me get on top of different aspects of my life and implement habits while feeling motivated to complete each task. 

I would make 2 suggestions to improve it:
 
1. Having the countdown visible while phone is locked. Sometimes I miss the end of the task and don’t hear the notification, being able to see the timer when my phone is locked would be awesome 

2. Being able to reorder / adjust the routine while I’m completing it. Getting partway through & realising I need to follow a different order of the tasks in the routine and not being able to adjust them without completely  restarting the entire routine & then amending the settings / reordering etc is sorta annoying. Having the ability to adjust them while it’s counting down would make it more intuitive.

The user interface is great. I love the simple design. I love how as you complete the tasks, the time that you will finish the routine updates. That,  for the time blind is a game changer. I love that it’s customizable to the users needs. 

  But it is soooooo buggy. Going to the settings page crashes the app. Sometimes it switches to the next task automatically and sometimes it waits for you to check it off and I can’t figure out why. When I tried to use it this morning it froze 5 times.  It’s great that you can run the routine at anytime but it still gives me updates/ reminders from the time it is programmed to run. So I get double reminders of different things at the same time which is confusing and breaks my flow because I want to open the app and fix it but can’t.   I also tried to set it up with shortcuts but the app does not show up in my shortcut options? The design is awesome I just wish it actually worked.  
  It would also be great if it had a widget that could run the routine without having to open or close the app.  Other productivity routine  apps have this and it makes the app worth paying for. 

So much is right with the design and soooo much is wrong with how it actually works. Is the developer planning on fixing these issues? If so I would happily pay for it.  But not now.

title: 좋습니다! 그러나 애플워치와 연동하면 오류가 꽤 있어요.
text:
첫번째로 애플워치로 루티너리를 시작하면 완료를 하더라도 휴대폰에서는 미완료된 상태로 시간이 계속 흐릅니다. 그로인해 휴대폰에서는 계속 루티너리 알람이 오는 경우가 있습니다.
두번째는 휴대폰으로 루티너리를 다시 완료시키면 이번엔 애플워치에서 미완료된 상태로 루티너리가 계속 실행 됩니다.
세번째는 다음날 애플워치로 루틴을 실행하려고 하니 이미 완료한 루틴이라고 되어있습니다. 시작하지도 않았는데 이미 완료가 되어있습니다.
마지막으로 루티너리를 다 끝내고나서 저의 애플워치는 화면이 꺼진후 2분 뒤에는 시계로 돌아가도록 설정 되어 있으나, 오직 루티너리만 시계화면으로 돌아가지 않고 루틴 목록을 계속 보여주고 있습니다.
이렇게 다소 불편한 오류가 생성되고 있는데, 얼른 처리해주시면 감사하겠습니다.
그 외 다른 부분은 모두 만족 합니다!

title: Nada é perfeito
text:
É um aplicativo interessante pois dá uma estimativa da hora que vai ser após cada atividade. Os ícones tornam a experiência interessante e você consegue ter ideias de com outros usuários que compartilham suas rotinas.

O único ponto que me fez desistir, é que embora entenda a necessidade do aplicativo estar aberto em algumas tarefas para manter o foco, outras eu gostaria que ficasse em segundo plano (as vezes a tarefa é ficar livre e olhar redes sociais).
Nesse momento o aplicativo não permite que você o feche, sem mandar mensagens e mais mensagens, o que acaba por ser mais irritante do que realmente útil.
Por esse motivo eu não consegui continuar.

Mas se a intenção for colocar menos quantidades de tarefas ou se deixar sempre aberto não for um problema, é um aplicativo muito bom!

title: La meilleure application pour être productif !
text:

Les + :
- Sa possibilité d’ajouter un compte à rebours pour respecter les timings 
- Un design épurée
- Prise en main facile 
- Une version gratuite complète 
- Des notifications vocales pour nous rappeler qu’une tâche vient de se finir 

Les Améliorations:
- Possibilité de mettre le compte à rebours sur la page de verrouillage de l’iPhone pour faciliter l’accès à l’application et connaître le temps restant ( j’espère vraiment voir une mise à jour sur ce sujet car c’est le point noir de Routinery)
- Des widgets indiquant le décompte du compte à rebours / des prochaines tâches à réaliser

Les - :
- Pas la possibilité d’acheter l’application à vie

text: 제가 사용해보고 좋아서, 아이들 아침 루틴으로 활용중인데요. 현재 루틴을 완료한 날이 50일정도 되는데,(그날 루틴 완료하면 날짜가 제대로 나옴) 나무형태로 바뀌면 26일에 멈춰있습니다. 아이들이 빨리 숲 보고 싶다고 나무 키우는 재미로 열심히 하고 있는데, 가지에서 더 이상 자라나지 않으니 속상해합니다. 어플 오류인 것 같은데, 빠른 보완 부탁드립니다. 그리고 저 역시 어플이 좋아 유료 구독까지 했었는데, 지금 이 어플을 사용하지 않는 이유가, 다른 분들이 말씀하신 것처럼 오류가 너무 많습니다. 멈추거나 순서가 바뀌거나 자기 벗대로 실행되거나 꺼지거나, 자잘한 오류가 너무 많습니다. 심플한 기능이 마음에 들어 선택한 건데, 오류가 많으니 아쉽습니다. 다만 대체할 다른 어플을 찾지 못해서, 문제점들이 충분히 개선된다면 다시 유료로 사용할 의사가 있습니다. 좋은 어플인만큼 빠른 보완으로 돌아오길 바랍니다.

The app is a good idea and I like using it, but I am sure it is terrible for the health of my phone battery.

title: I'm loving the app
text: I'm from Brazil, and I'm loving the app, the app is helping me organize myself on a daily basis, before I had a lot of difficulty starting and finishing everyday tasks, due to my Attention Deficit Disorder condition ( ADD). I used to always forget what I needed to do, and at the end of the day I felt frustrated. Today with the app, I feel useful! My mood has improved and I feel less irritable. A suggestion that would help me a lot was to have the clock count on the screen, for example. if I start at 6:00 am, and do 3 habits of 5 minutes, it would help to have the information that would end the whole routine at 6:15 am on the app screen, for example. so this time I have to mentally calculate what time my routine will be finished. If I'm late or a little overtime, it would be interesting for the app to inform me at what time the routine would end due to the delay of some habit. I hope I was clear and helped. I am grateful for the app.
author: Castiel o anjo

text: Incredible for ADHD. I'm completely timeblind, struggle with building and following routines, and suck at getting up in the mornings. I've been using Routinery for a couple of weeks. It's made a bigger difference to my ability to go to bed and get up on time than anything else I've ever tried, I've only been late to work twice (which for me is a huge improvement), and I've even been early a couple of times. Highly recommend for anyone who struggles with routine and timekeeping.

title: Really good but there is one BIG issue
text:
I’ve been using this app for a while and overall it is really good. I love how I can make as many routines as possible and the little notification at the top when you are done. But I still see some issues within this app that I want to go over right now.
1) No option to see notes when doing task. For example, I have a specific exercise routine whenever it pops up for half an hour, but I can’t see what to do specifically when it pops up. So what even is the point of it being there when I can’t see it?

2) No dark mode - not much of an issue it’s just that I have a night time and evening routine and with the interface blinding my eyes it just doesn’t set the mood 

3) not loud enough
There needs to be some sort of option so I can have this app practically yelling at me to get my stuff together for the day. I am awful at following things with a list which is why I am trying to better myself with this app. It would help a ton if this app could be louder with notifications and just more aggressive with sounds. 

That’s all I have to say. If you are reading this and considering downloading the app, you really should you won’t regret it. ❤️

title: 앱 오류 버그가 너무 많아요
text:
유료로 구독해서 쓰고 있는데 이걸 돈 받고 판다고? 생각이 들 정도로 버그가 너무 심합니다.
1. 루틴 완료 시점 애매
분명 마지막 루틴까지 끝냈는데도 불구하고 완료로 체크가 안됩니다. 종료 시점이 어디인지를 모르겠네요.
2. 애플워치와 호환성
애플워치에서 실행할 수 있고 시간도 확인 할 수 있지만 동기화가 안됩니다. 예를 들어서 1번과 마찬가지로 애플워치에서 루틴을 끝내도 어플내에서는 이걸 체크 안하거나, 반대의 경우도 있었습니다.
3. 앱 실행 안됨
참다참다 결국 3번문제로 이렇게 장문의 리뷰를 남기게되는데요 … 오늘 애플워치로 루틴 완료후에 내일 루틴을 설정하러 어플을 실행할려고 하니 먹통이 되었습니다. 1년전에도 이러한 에로사항 때문에 삭제했는데 전혀 개선되어있지 않군요?? 이미 개발이 끝나서 버그 수정 패치를 안하시는건지 의문이 듭니다…

그래도 어플 덕분에 루틴을 실천할 수 있다는 장점하나로 결제한건데 앱 실행안되는건 좀 심하네요.

title: 欠かせないものになりました！
text:
子育て・ダブルワークをしている慌ただしい毎日で、自分がADHD(不注意多め)だと実感することが増えてきていました。

最も苦手としていたのが、ルーティーンをこなすこと。考えなくても動けるルーティーンが必要と感じていましたが、それができず、忘れ物・遅刻・優先順位を考えない行動をしてしまっていました。

様々なアプリを使ってきましたが、ルーティナリーが1番合っていました。(厳密に言うと、ルーティナリーも始めは使いこなせず、他をあたったこともありました。)

朝のルーティーン・夕方以降のルーティーンは、ほぼ固定で毎日使い、自分の裁量で仕事や私用をする昼間も、その日だけの予定を入力して、時間の使い方に問題ないか確認した上で、スタートをしています。そのおかげで、ほんの10分でも【急ぎではないが重要】なことをする時間の確保と集中ができるようになりました。また、ルーティナリーが終了する時刻が、進み具合により、予測できることが、車のナビの到着予測みたいで、本当に助かっています。

途中でルーティナリーを放置してしまっている自分に気づいたり、順番の入れ替え・スキップが必要になったりと、完璧にこなせるわけではありませんが、7割できれば合格と思うように、自分に言い聞かせています。

また、ふとひらめきややるべきこと・買うべき物が浮かんだ時のために、メモ帳をスマホの横において、都度、記入できるように工夫しました。そのおかげである程度、脱線も防げています。

バッテリーの減りが速いことと日本語がおかしいことは、今後の改善を期待しています。(その点で星を4つにしました)

title: issues
text:
The overall app is quite useful. i have adhd and so struggle with time management and keeping routines, so this was very useful when i found it. HOWEVER, there have been some bugs/issues that have started happening the last few months/weeks.  
Now it just loads and loads when i open it, and unless i open it via a notification on my phone it just doesn’t open. it’s extremely annoying. Sometimes the voice reminder will just give a random step instead of what’s next. For example, “shower will end automatically, get ready for shower “ like??? (wash bath is after shower). it’s most irritating when it says something random like this, but i actually need the next step, e.g. one of the steps is to take my meds - if it says “stretch will end automatically in 1min, move onto brush teeth” but then will use up the Meds time and so has completely defeated the purpose of the reminder. Also, When you stop the routine and get beck to it later (let’s say a few hours) it says “sorry we’re having problems, the tech team are sorting it”,, but if i am to simply swipe skip on all the remaining steps and restart the routine it works?? took a while to get to this loophole. a little disappointing you have to pay for more than 2 routines (and i did consider, but then all these bugs started and i don’t want to pay for something that’s proving to be quite useless). It’s a shame, this didn’t really happen when i first got the app and would be such a massive help if it didn’t have these bugs.

title: Great app for ADHD - couple adjustments needed
text:
Here’s what I like:

- Less clutter than other apps like this which helps you stay focused. 

- I love the emoji’s they are better than the apple ones for sure! They could learn from you. 

- The audio reminder of a persons voice saying it’s time for the next task is really helpful and not alarming. 

- The inspirational quotes in the top of the screen. 

- The little encouragements the app gives you. Super important for RSD with ADHD. 

- You can pause and add more time to a task. 

What I’d like to see changed/added:

- “Timer start screen settings” is UNRESPONSIVE AT ALL TIMES 
 
- More musical tones to choose from for reminders to start new tasks please 

- Be able to add emojis from app ( which are awesome 😎) to sub routines in context section. ( My context here is that it allows a shortcut for my brain to know what I’m doing next without being overwhelmed by words )

- Be able to auto select “move task to end” as the response when I want to skip. - especially helpful for when making new habits and finding what works and what doesn’t. This automated section instead of having to select away from “skip today” doesn’t give me an out to cheat the routine and actually complete it and it doesn’t feel like I’m failing either. 

Overall a wonderful app! I have tried dozens of apps and this one works. Thank you. I look forward to your new additions!

title: The best app for ADHD/autistic people in need of structure
text:
I’m autistic and when I’m alone I have trouble meeting my daily needs and responsibilities either because I don’t think about them, because I don’t realise how long they take, or because I get side tracked easily. This app remedies all those problems!

It’s the first time I ever pay a subscription for an app and it’s quite amazing. I use it every day when my spouse is away and thanks to that I can maintain a healthy schedule, feed myself on time, get enough sleep, etc. 

I do have a small bug though: whenever the app is launched (in the background or not), it increases the sound of all notifications. So for example if I’m on the app and I receive a text, the notification is painfully loud even though my settings say it’s at the lowest possible sound level. Same with the sounds on the app, they sometimes get incredibly loud and I have yet to find a pattern to this. I’m on iOS 16.5.1 with an iPhone 12. 

But anyways, apart from this small bug the app is absolutely amazing and 100% worth the money! To the developers: you guys are awesome!

title: ルーティンアプリ日々活用してます。
text: こちらのアプリは使い勝手が良く、いつも重宝させていただいです。 ルーティンナリーアプリのおかげで毎日運動を継続して続けることができ早、６ヶ月続きました。自信がつき、見た目もだいぶん変わったのが実感できます。大変ありがたいです。 今回投稿させていただいたのは、先日のアップデートの件で、ルーティンの継続日が0にリセットされていたことで投稿させていただきました。毎日数字を見るのが好きになって、199日続いてて、200日目で0にリセットされてたので残念な気持ちがあり投稿させていただきました。元の継続日数に戻らないでしょうか。なくてはならないアプリなので残念です。

title: The recent update has worsened the app.
text: The app often glitches and flips your screen when you open it after having had it run in the background, tasks end without giving you any notification or even warning that the app has closed itself in the background and you may not be able to hear the notifications. The white noise doesn’t always turn on when you try to turn it on, it sometimes adds extra time to your tasks on its own. I have had routinery for over a year now, and before it wasn’t perfect,  but it was manageable;  now it’s almost unusable. I was waiting for an update hoping there would be positive improvements but instead we got an app that can’t even perform its most basic function. I am deeply disappointed, perhaps this kind of app just isn’t compatible with IOS, idk. My routines have been affected too much by Routinery, and I will now be deleting the app.

title: New game - Find the bug

3.15.87 - Transferred all routines into Inactive.

3.16.0 - Even if voice reminders are off, it keeps yapping every 2-5 minutes + ETA of end of the routine keeps increasing even if the task time is not completed.

title: Such a good app :)
text: I find I tend to struggle with my motivation quite frequently, I mentally give myself tasks to do like taking my dogs for a walk, organising my room, getting up early and doing something productive etc you get the idea, but I always find that my urge to not do it takes over and I end up doing nothing and “moping” all day making me feel down and upset that I couldn’t bring myself to do such simple tasks. I’ve tried so many apps for productivity and motivation and they tend to just not help at all, however my friend made me aware of this app and it has helped me so much especially during school times, it gives me the motivation to get things done and even if I just get a small few things done it makes me feel so much more accomplished. If anyone is considering downloading this app honestly do it! Even without paying for the subscription, there’s no adds or annoying subscription adverts it still works amazingly. I deleted the app as I stopped using it during my summer break but I begin sixth form very soon and I’m re downloading the app. Anyone considering it, do it, and if you can afford it maybe even pay for the subscription because even just the free version is amazing :))

title: Notifications stopped after 3 days
text:
Not sure how to get in touch with the developers to ask for support, but they seem pretty active responding to reviews so hoping for some help. 

Recently diagnosed with ADHD, I’ve been looking for something to help me create and consistently follow routines to benefit my physical and mental health. This app came highly recommended through several users via blogs, Reddit posts, and general forums. I wasn’t so keen on the subscription price tag, but the free version lets you build a couple of routines so I figured I’d try it out. 

The app worked great - so much better than expected. Yes a modicum of this success is due to the initial novelty, but the combination of intuitive UI, minimalist display, countdown times and voice reminders meant that I was immediately doing habits daily that I’d been trying to build for years. The app was such a hit with my brain that I decided if I could make it 3 days I would pay for 12 months. 

Then my notifications stopped. I’ve tried reinstalling the app, disabling and re-enabling notifications form system settings and app settings. I’ve set notifications to persistent and set them to remind me every 5 minutes. But the notifications just don’t seem to be firing. 

I’m really hoping there is a fix because for 3 glorious days I actually felt a little like I had my life together, but this app won’t work for me if the onus is on me to remember to launch it. 

Highly recommend giving this app a trial run, and hoping I can get the notification issue sorted so I can give this app the 5 star review I think it deserves.

text: 컨셉은 좋지만 후발주자가 나온다면 바로 따라잡힐 앱. 1. 갤럭시 모바일 - 워치 간 동기화 미비 : 폰화면에서 먼저 실행 후 워치를 해야하는 건 그렇다 칠 수 있는데, 폰 화면이 꺼지면 동기화가 또 꺼집니다. 갤럭시는 화면 계속 켜둠 기능이 없기 때문에 최대 10분입니다. 결국은 워치가 있어도 핸드폰으로만 조작할 수 있는 셈입니다. 그래도 이건 갤럭시의 문제라고 생각합니다. 2. 프리미엄 계정의 적은 혜택 : 루틴을 여러개 추가하고, 루틴 지킨 시간대를 볼 수 있는 거 말고는 도저히 장점을 모르겠습니다. 고작 시간대 보자고 매달 돈 내기가 아까워서 체험 끝나고는 결제하지 않았어요. 겨우 이 정도 혜택으로도 많은 사람들이 결제를 하나봅니다. 프리미엄 아이콘도 너무 적고요. 추가 불만 사항 1) 앱 실행 중에도 상단 상태표시줄에 앱이 떠있질 않습니다. 2) 실수로 다음 할 일 누르고 저장해버리면 그 전 할 일로 돌아갈 방법이 없습니다.

title: Very good
text:
I find this really helpful for my morning routine. I have it setup with Shortcuts so that when I disconnect from charging in the morning, it starts the routine.

It keeps me from forgetting things or getting too distracted. Also helps to do things I may feel lazy about. Since you’re kind of turning your brain off and doing what it says, you’re more likely to just do it instead of talking yourself out of it.

Also in that spirit, I make the early tasks very simple while I’m still sleepy. Literally “get out of bed”, “open the blinds”, “put on workout clothes”, “go downstairs”, etc. Then I have more general tasks with bigger blocks of time later on.

Since it estimates when you’ll be done, it helps to keep things in balance. If I see I’m running late and my routine will go past the start of my first work meeting, I can do a shorter meditation or exercise session, instead of suddenly noticing the time and having to rush around.

There’s been bugs in the past (like the voice repeating or the timer not showing up on the dynamic island & Lock Screen), but those big ones have been fixed. The voice is pretty robotic and I didn’t like it at first, but it also makes me want to finish on time to avoid hearing it lol.

Sometimes I wish you could link routines or put routines inside other routines so you could more easily have variations on diff days or move multiple tasks around at once, but I’m not sure there’d be a way to do it without making things too complicated. It works well enough most of the time now anyway.
author: Invidflower

title: Routines are great, Premium not so much
text:
The routine creation and interface are very functional from a user perspective.

However, the restriction on the number of routines for free users is almost ridiculous considering the apps subscription based premium access. There is zero desire from a user perspective to continuously pay for access to more routines, as there is no guarantee that the prices won’t increase over time, and the overall shift towards subscription based services is already too much. A one time payment for premium is justifiable - but not a subscription. Users deserve to own premium rather than pay for access to it.

I have had the app for more than a year and will never buy premium if it continues to be a subscription service. If it were available as a one time purchase, I would buy premium immediately.

text:

title: Updated: Recent Changes Unfortunate
text:
Edit: I realized to ask for more clarification from the creators at a later time, as it sounded like I was unable to easily edit the app due to a fixable bug. Apparently, this is no longer a feature. I had to stop using the app while my subscription was going as this was its most important feature for me. I can't find an app that is easy to edit and use but has some variety. I would think this would be important for many neurodivergent people, but apparently, I am an outlier even amongst them, which is incredibly discouraging. We barely have niche markets anymore. So it's very depressing to assume that as technology progresses, accessibility will likely decrease, even though in theory it should improve.

Previous Review:

Note: might change the rating at some point (was four, now is three, in theory it is closer to five). I used to use this app every day, but one of my favorite aspects—which is essential for me in any app like this—was the ability to edit my routine on the go. And the app makers are friendly and responsive. The latest update makes reordering easier, but no longer allows one to change the name of any of the tasks at hand. I’ve been testing it after each update to see if it’s changed. So far, no dice. Another significant issues are that it drains a LOT of battery and messes with the audio on my phone to the point that it will blast your ears out lol. This is frankly more of an iPhone problem than just this app (iPhone refuses to acknowledge this, in spite of LOTS of evidence; presumably it’ll cost them less to get sued by those with ear damage than to make the change), but it does depend on the app to an extent. Taking a break from this app has helped my battery and ears a lot. It’s possible the latest updates have also addressed that as they now have volume levels in the app. Anyway, I’m a bit sad to stop using it, but I might end up having to delete. Otherwise, it’s a very fun, cute, and flexible app.

title: I need a ‘dumb” mode where a timer isn’t trying to direct me
text: I’m finding it hard to grapple with these timer based apps that try to direct me. I wasn’t to complete things in my own time but need checklists to keep myself on track. I understand the philosophy of routines that build habits like this but I need to also be able to check things off my todo list without starting a timer and going through things in sequence. I need more flexibility. A dumb mode where I can just check off what I’ve already done and look over what’s left etc very quickly. I’m not a robot I do things at different times, for different durations and in different orders but I still need something to keep me on track with daily repeating todos and reminders. I find myself wrestling with this app. Would work if I could just add tasks without durations and complete them without starting the timer.
